titolo: Amplitude speeds product updates to 1–2 days using OpenAI agents
descr: Amplitude’s Wave agent, built on OpenAI models, identifies features, assists coding, and tracks impact, cutting rollout time to under two days.
paragrafi: Amplitude announced that its proactive product agent, Wave, now runs on OpenAI models.
Wave scans user data, suggests what to build, and hands off tasks to coding agents that generate implementation code.
The system also measures the effect of changes, allowing teams to see results quickly.
Amplitude reports that the end‑to‑end cycle from idea to shipped change now takes 1–2 days.
The approach demonstrates how commercial products can use large language models to accelerate development.
perche: For AI users, the case shows how OpenAI models can automate feature ideation and code generation, shortening development cycles. Free‑model enthusiasts see a contrast with top‑ranked community models like Kimi K3 and GLM‑5.3, which remain popular alternatives for those seeking open or local solutions.
